Hi Sahil —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our partner-led discovery:  

- Summary: We covered Redwood’s hosted API, Dedicated options for marketplace listings, and the typical integration flow for CloudBridge marketplace partners. You mentioned two key constraints: listing latency SLAs for discovery endpoints and needing a self-serve procurement path in the marketplace portal.

- Action items I captured:
  1) Redwood to propose a 60-minute technical deep dive (runtime + marketplace integration) with your GSI contact to align on network/topology and listing requirements.
  2) Share a draft demo agenda and marketplace checklist (attached).
  3) Introduce Mateo (solutions engineer) to discuss deployment patterns and sample benchmark expectations.

Proposed slots for the technical deep dive: Oct 6 or Oct 7 (PDT). I opened a tentative 60m window here: https://cal.com/redwood/demo-cloudbridge-60m. Would love to lock a time that works for Rebecca and your GSIs.

Attaching a draft agenda + checklist. If this looks good I’ll send a formal calendar invite and a short pre-read for the GSI team.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
